item.title: Pairwise AUC Optimization Needs Corrective Power: A Unified View
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Direct pairwise AUC-surrogate training is attractive because it trains toward the ranking metric used at test time, especially under class imbalance.

Direct pairwise AUC-surrogate training is attractive because it trains toward the ranking metric used at test time, especially under class imbalance. This creates a direct alignment between the training objective and the evaluation metric, but such metric alignment alone does not guarantee that stochastic training remains corrective. We study this gap through Corrective Power: whether pairwise mini-batch updates produce stronger and more reliable improvements for more severe positive-negative ranking errors. Our main observation is that direct pairwise training can enter regions where severe errors remain common but no longer produce useful corrective motion. In such regions, even the mini-batch noise that would normally help SGD move along the steepest severe-error correction direction can become much weaker. In this paper, we seek a theoretical explanation for this by exploring the degenerate property of the U-statistics formed from the pairwise gradients therein. item.title: PairIT: Autoregressive Transformers for Low-Data Molecule Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Generating novel molecules with desired properties is a central challenge in drug discovery.

Generating novel molecules with desired properties is a central challenge in drug discovery. Although foundational work focused on de novo generation, practical use cases require a more complex setting: conditioning on an initial seed molecule, optimizing multiple properties, and operating in data-sparse regimes. We introduce PairIT, a flexible training framework for autoregressive transformers over SMILES sequences that enables seeded generation by learning from pairs of structurally similar molecules. By leveraging matched pairs, the model learns to generate local, chemically meaningful edits that improve a property of the seed molecule. Prompt tokens extend this framework by specifying the target property, desired direction, and approximate magnitude of change. Multiple prompt tokens can be concatenated to enable multi-property optimization at inference time. For properties where pair supervision alone is insufficient, reinforcement learning post-training can further improve optimization, providing a tunable trade-off between proximity to the seed and the optimization objective. PairIT naturally supports pretraining on a large dataset and fine-tuning on a smaller dataset, which …

item.title: PSA: A Pruning-Friendly Sparse-Aware Accelerator for Efficient Sparse Convolution in SNNs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 SNN 中脉冲稀疏与剪枝稀疏叠加产生高度不规则的稀疏负载，现有加速器难以高效执行。

方法 PSA 三项设计：SAMA 数据流对齐稀疏脉冲索引、把不规则激活转成连续计算流；SIG-im2col 机制以低映射与内存开销把稀疏卷积片上转换为 SpMM；集成轻量剪枝友好的门控机制，直接支持已剪枝 SNN。

关键数字 ResNet-18/CIFAR-10 上，相比稠密基线能效提升 4.45 倍，能量-时延积（EDP）降低 18.52 倍。

item.title: PN-Mix: Pair-Norm Guided Mixed-Precision Key Cache Quantization for Efficient Long-Output LLM Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 长输出推理受 KV cache 内存与带宽瓶颈制约；2-bit 低比特量化严重损害精度，已有混合精度 key cache 方法仅凭 key 统计估计通道重要性。

方法 在 RoPE 通道对层面做注意力 logit 扰动分析，发现 query-key 对范数积大的通道对上量化误差对 logit 波动贡献显著；据此提出 PN-Mix：把更高精度分配给显著通道对，一次在 prefill 阶段识别、整个解码阶段复用。

关键数字 平均 2.26-bit 精度下，平均准确率持平或优于使用 2.32–2.39 bit 的已有混合精度方法（推理、代码生成、AIME 基准）；Pareto 扫描中可平滑降至 1.5 bit，而对比基线在 2.25 bit 以下明显跳水。

为什么值得看 为低比特 KV 量化给出可操作的通道对显著性判据，对推理/代码等长输出场景尤其有用。

item.description:

The Practical Molecular Optimization (PMO) benchmark standardized evaluation in molecular optimization, but it is built on simple property-based oracles that do not capture structure-based drug design.

The Practical Molecular Optimization (PMO) benchmark standardized evaluation in molecular optimization, but it is built on simple property-based oracles that do not capture structure-based drug design. As the field has moved to docking-based objectives, evaluation practice has become unstandardized, and different methods report results on different docking tasks, often without a shared protocol for fair comparison or sample-efficiency constraints. To address this, we introduce Practical Molecular Optimization for Docking (PMO-Dock), a benchmark and protocol for docking-based optimization consisting of 25 tasks covering hit generation, lead optimization, and a new specificity task requiring strong on-target binding while penalizing off-target interactions. The protocol separates model development from final evaluation: validation tasks are used for hyperparameter tuning, and test tasks are held out for final evaluation and are not used during development. Evaluation on the test tasks is done under a strict oracle budget to reflect realistic drug-discovery settings. item.title: Outcome-Routed Distillation and Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

On-policy distillation provides dense supervision on the student's own samples, but its targets still come from the teacher.

On-policy distillation provides dense supervision on the student's own samples, but its targets still come from the teacher. Verifier reinforcement learning (RL) instead uses an outcome signal, but it provides no direct constraint on capabilities outside the verifier. Combining the two is difficult for diffusion language models (dLLMs), because bidirectional denoising makes the policy likelihoods required by ratio-based RL unreliable. We develop a likelihood-free pipeline for a mixture-of-experts dLLM. Each rollout group is routed by verifier outcome. Mixed groups use ratio-free, group-centred REINFORCE. If every student rollout fails but a teacher succeeds, the model receives dense KL supervision on the student's denoising canvases. All other groups are skipped. A KL term anchored to the distilled checkpoint limits changes outside the verifier reward. The tool-calling teacher succeeds on only 18.6% of the training prompts. At 24 denoising steps, distillation exceeds the teacher by 6.77 percentage points, and routing improves the distilled checkpoint by a further 18.31 points. Routing lowers reasoning-trace accuracy by 0.71 points but raises direct-answer accuracy on the same items…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Tabular foundation models enable in-context learning by predicting unseen observations from a labeled support table without task-specific parameter updates.

Tabular foundation models enable in-context learning by predicting unseen observations from a labeled support table without task-specific parameter updates. Despite recent advances, most existing approaches rely on dense architectures that apply the same transformations across features and datasets. We introduce OrionMoE-Small, a compact tabular foundation model that combines distribution-aware representations with dataset-conditioned sparse mixture-of-experts computation. Built on a dual-axis Transformer architecture, OrionMoE-Small selectively activates experts along the feature axis, with routing decisions informed by both individual feature representations and the broader dataset context. This design enables adaptive allocation of computation across heterogeneous tabular problems while retaining a shared computational pathway across tasks. OrionMoE-Small is pretrained entirely on synthetic classification tasks generated from a structured causal prior and performs downstream prediction without gradient-based adaptation. item.title: Optimizing Sparse Boolean Rule Networks using Mixed Integer Linear Programming
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

We study the problem of learning accurate and cognitively simple binary classifiers that are directly interpretable as Boolean rules.

We study the problem of learning accurate and cognitively simple binary classifiers that are directly interpretable as Boolean rules. We propose mixed integer linear programming (MILP) formulations for training sparse disjunctive normal form (DNF) networks, viewed as small networks with a conjunctive hidden layer and a disjunctive output layer. Contrary to previous work that uses MILP for inductive rule learning, we start with a fixed network structure, for which we then find optimal weights. A regularized objective explicitly trades off misclassification costs against sparsity, yielding globally optimized rule sets. Our main technical contribution is an enhanced formulation that substantially reduces the number of integer decision variables and eliminates redundant constraints, while preserving exact Boolean semantics for all feasible solutions. Furthermore, we develop a combined approach based on initialization and dropout to break symmetries in the weights between rules, mitigating redundancy, and encouraging more diverse and stable rule representations. item.title: One Task, Many Interfaces: Simple Cross-Interface Consistency Training Improves LLM Agent Robustness
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Post-training binds the competence of an LLM agent to the interface it was trained on.

Post-training binds the competence of an LLM agent to the interface it was trained on. Semantics-preserving perturbations of that interface, such as renaming an action or changing the notation, leave the underlying task unchanged yet make the agent worse at it. Scoring each sample independently means interface randomization only broadens this dependence from a single interface to the training interface distribution, so out-of-distribution perturbations still degrade the agent. We propose Cross-Interface Policy Regularization (CIPR), a self-supervised objective that replaces action names with uninformative identifiers and presents each training sample under two interfaces in which equivalent actions are identified by construction. CIPR penalizes the KL divergence between the action distributions induced under the two interfaces, so the policy behaves consistently across them. We evaluate CIPR in both supervised and reinforcement-learning post-training, where it improves robustness. On agentic function calling, held-out interface perturbations reduce the accuracy of a post-trained agent by nearly 25%, and CIPR recovers 10.5% while leaving accuracy on the unchanged interface intact.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: On the Limits of Representation-Based Test-Time Adaptation for Multimodal LLMs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Vision-language models suffer significant accuracy drops under common corruptions.

Vision-language models suffer significant accuracy drops under common corruptions. While test-time adaptation (TTA) successfully mitigates these shifts in CLIP-like contrastive models, its application to generative multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remains underexplored and uniquely challenging due to their sequential token generation. In this work, we demonstrate that representation-based TTA fails to recover performance in MLLMs. Our experiments reveal that even when violating standard TTA assumptions by leveraging target data offline, sample-blind feature alignment recovers only marginal accuracy. We attribute this failure to the nature of corruption shifts: unlike CLIP-like architectures, which benefit from a shared domain-shift direction within a single pooled classification embedding, MLLM visual token sequence shifts are nearly orthogonal and span the full embedding space.These findings bound what any sample-blind, position-shared correction at a single encoder site can achieve, establishing that representation-space interventions alone might be insufficient to ensure corruption robustness in MLLMs.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

In this paper we provide an introduction to some of the efficient features of the Raspberry Pi Pico (RP2) family of microconroller boards (RP2040 and RP2350).

In this paper we provide an introduction to some of the efficient features of the Raspberry Pi Pico (RP2) family of microconroller boards (RP2040 and RP2350). More exactly, we show how to use PIO (Programmable Input/Output) and DMA (Direct Memory Access) to program the RP2 boards for efficient DAC (Digital to Analog) and ADC (Analog to Digital) conversions. Using OP-AMPS (Operational Amplifiers) we also show how to build a minimal electronic frontend interface for signal input/output. Finally, we integrate all these components into a product, the O-SCOPE, which is a practical and easy to use oscilloscope and wave function generator. The RP2 component of the O-SCOPE is built using Micropython, while the user interface is developed using vanilla Javascript and it runs on the web browser of any computer, interacting with the RP2 board via the Web Serial API. The O-SCOPE web interface is hosted on GitHub Pages such that it is directly accessible everywhere using a web browser, such that no local installation is required. item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Unlearning aims to remove selected knowledge from large language models to mitigate privacy and safety risks while preserving useful capabilities.

Unlearning aims to remove selected knowledge from large language models to mitigate privacy and safety risks while preserving useful capabilities. For models that continue to be fine-tuned after release, this goal is insufficient: they must also resist relearning the deleted knowledge while preserving plasticity, the ability to learn new tasks. Existing defenses train against simulated relearning while trying to preserve useful capabilities, but low relearning alone cannot distinguish selective resistance from a general loss of plasticity. Evaluating preservation after an update requires deciding what the updated model should remain close to. A pre-update reference penalizes useful changes induced by the update simply because they depart from earlier outputs. We therefore formulate the reference-timing hypothesis that, at comparable target suppression, an update-matched reference better preserves plasticity than a pre-update one. item.title: New Model, Old Habits: Behavior Transfer under Model Swapping in Multi-Session LLM Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Multi-session agents can switch between LLMs to balance performance and inference cost.

Multi-session agents can switch between LLMs to balance performance and inference cost. Such switches require transferring a history for continuity, yet their effects on the recipient remain underexplored. Through controlled experiments with multi-session tasks, we uncover behavior transfer: recipients tend to adopt reasoning and action patterns from the models that generated their histories. This effect is most evident with raw-history transfer but is substantially reduced by summarization. Based on these findings, we propose Direction- and Authorship-aware Summarization of History (DASH) that preserves stronger-model behavior while minimizing weak-to-strong transfer via summarization. Experiments with repeated swaps show that DASH outperforms raw-history transfer and naive summarization baselines. These results suggest that effective multi-model orchestration requires considering not only which model to use, but also which behavioral patterns to carry forward.

item.title: NeuroDETR: Multiscale Discrete Spatiotemporal Tokenization for Asynchronous EEG Event Detection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Asynchronous EEG event detection supports practical brain-computer interfaces by identifying event classes and temporal boundaries directly from continuous recordings without predefined event boundaries at inference time.

Asynchronous EEG event detection supports practical brain-computer interfaces by identifying event classes and temporal boundaries directly from continuous recordings without predefined event boundaries at inference time. The primary challenge lies in extracting event-related patterns embedded in ongoing background activity. To address this, we propose \textbf{NeuroDETR}, a discrete spatiotemporal multiscale framework that combines structured tokenization with event-aware feature refinement. Multiscale temporal codebooks capture brief responses and sustained dynamics, while Spatial-Pyramid VQ hierarchically encodes spatial structure across EEG channels. These complementary representations form a compact event memory for jointly classifying events and estimating their onsets and offsets. Before tokenization, we apply FOCAL, an event-aware sparse attention module that uses predicted event presence to guide temporal feature refinement and spatial aggregation, emphasizing likely event periods while preserving context across the recording. Experiments on eight EEG datasets that span diverse paradigms demonstrate state-of-the-art performance. These findings provide a basis for the develo…

item.title: Neural Wasserstein Splines: Representation-Invariant Second-Order Priors for Trajectory Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Population dynamics are often observed only as unpaired snapshots, which leave the evolution between measurements underdetermined.

Population dynamics are often observed only as unpaired snapshots, which leave the evolution between measurements underdetermined. Second-order regularization can constrain it, but a penalty on the accelerations of sampled particles is a prior on joint particle paths, and different particle representations of the same marginal curve can have different acceleration costs. We therefore introduce Neural Wasserstein Splines (NWSP), a sample-based method that learns a continuous population curve under a Wasserstein smoothness prior. A neural network maps latent variables to the control points of a cubic spline in time, so samples at any time come from the spline basis without numerical integration. We project the generator's velocity onto gradients of a finite dictionary of scalar potentials and differentiate this measure-dependent projection in time, obtaining a finite-dimensional surrogate for the intrinsic Wasserstein acceleration, trained jointly with distributional fit losses. For a fixed dictionary and ridge parameter, we prove that the population penalty depends only on the marginal curve and bound its sensitivity to moment-estimation errors. item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 条件记忆（查找表）扩展语言模型容量，但整张嵌入表必须常驻可用，存储负担沉重。

方法 提出条件程序（CP）：只重构输入实际请求的表行；每行用短码加局部尺度表示，重构程序全表共享；以高斯栅格、范数恢复和可独立解码的行记录实例化。

关键数字 2-bit 编码相对 2-bit 就近舍入将输出 KL 降低 41–63%；三个 n-gram 记忆家族上同等存储预算下优于所测拟合码本与低秩残差变体；DeepSeek 的查找表从 203GB 压缩到 51GB。

item.title: Momentum, Commentary Tone, and Earnings Surprise in LLM Financial Forecasts
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Which inputs drive a language model's financial forecast?

Which inputs drive a language model's financial forecast? We construct synthetic earnings announcements that independently reverse 20-day momentum, non-informational commentary tone, and whether fixed actual EPS beats a manipulated consensus. Six instruction/chat checkpoint conversions from four families (0.49-7.61B base parameters) receive 2,016 prompts each under a direct-answer Q8_0 protocol. The design includes 24 numerical blocks, six commentary pairs, profits and losses, rising and falling annual EPS, and two surprise sizes. Both A/B answer assignments and U/D cover all 384 primary scenarios per conversion. We estimate matched changes in conditional answer-prefix scores, not calibrated market probabilities. Across these checkpoints, the primary EPS contrast ranges from -0.19 to 86.80 percentage points. The magnitude of the primary signed tone contrast exceeds that of EPS in 5 of six models, and momentum exceeds it in 5. Natural-word numerical diagnostic accuracy ranges from 51.0 to 95.8 percent. Answer-encoding, wording, context, and conversion controls qualify these results. The experiment measures observable input reliance and numerical recognition; it establishes neither a…

item.title: Minimum RISC-V: Maximum FPGA Efficiency
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 FPGA 软处理器系统（含内存）常占用不成比例的资源面积，性能却相对器件潜力平平。

方法 设计轻量深流水线 RISC-V 核，并提出应用二进制与专用处理器实例同步编译的优化：指令展开为应用特定编码，综合时删除未使用的数据通路与译码逻辑；产物保持汇编器兼容，但不再与通用 RISC-V 二进制兼容。

关键数字 中档器件上主频超 700 MHz、理想条件每时钟退休一条指令；最小核仅 170 个 ALM，在 Altera Agilex-5 上 775 MHz 收敛时序；RV32I/RV32M/RV32F 三种配置验证；核可装入确定性面积连续步进重复排布，便于多核密度规划。

为什么值得看 应用专属软核的极致面积效率路线，适合密集软核与确定性布局场景。

item.title: Memory-Efficient Subspace Optimization with Residual Correction: From Momentum SGD to Muon
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 内存高效子空间优化可降低 LLM 训练内存成本，但已有算法依赖随机梯度的主奇异子空间，训练后期梯度噪声可能主导子空间、阻碍收敛。

方法 采用残差校正框架：优化器状态维持在子空间内，正交残差梯度加回参数更新；与动量 SGD 结合得 SMRC（引入子空间虚拟迭代解开动量与残差校正的耦合），与 Muon 结合得 PMRC（对投影动量施加矩阵符号）；两者均设计周期性重算基的多阶段变体，并用边界校正保持虚拟迭代跨阶段一致。

关键数字 SMRC 与 PMRC 分别证得 O(T^-1/4) 收敛率，与全空间动量 SGD、全空间 Muon 持平；多阶段变体保持同阶速率；实验确认有效性与效率（摘要未给具体内存节省数字）。

为什么值得看 为"动量 SGD 到 Muon"的子空间省内存训练补齐收敛理论，做大模型训练内存优化方向值得读。

item.title: Memorilla: Latent Semantic Memory for LLMs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Memory enables large language models (LLMs) to use information beyond their parameters, such as past user conversations, long documents, or an agent's earlier actions.

Memory enables large language models (LLMs) to use information beyond their parameters, such as past user conversations, long documents, or an agent's earlier actions. For a frozen LLM, access to this accumulated knowledge is limited to what a memory system places in its context window. However, gathering and combining relevant information needed for each query while keeping the model's context short remains challenging for existing systems. Here we introduce Memorilla, a memory system that gathers information from an entire document collection into a fixed number of query-dependent 'memory tokens' for a frozen LLM. Memorilla encodes documents (such as user chats, book chapters) once into reusable embeddings, then learns to retrieve and place query-specific information in the LLM's input embedding space. Using only 16 memory tokens, Memorilla achieves the best performance against baselines including Mem0 and MemoRAG on five of eight benchmarks spanning personalization, long-document and knowledge-intensive question answering. Notably, on FactKG, it reaches 84.33% accuracy versus 80.43% with full-context inference, while using 108x fewer tokens to represent the source documents. Fur…

item.title: MFSA: A Multi-Format Systolic Array with Native Micro Scaling Support
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 AI 负载混合使用 BF16/FP8/FP4/MX/INT 等多种低精度格式，硬件需灵活且高效地原生支持。

方法 MFSA 是权重驻留的多格式脉动阵列：PE 级用由开源跨精度 FPU 扩展的 DPA-PE，以共享数据通路支持 FP32 到 INT4 并按格式比例扩展吞吐；阵列级用在线块尺度重定基（OBSR），在块边界把块尺度折入 FP32 部分和，无需第二套跨块累加器。

关键数字 TSMC 28nm、1GHz 下，BF16/FP8/FP4 级联基线面积是单格式 DPA-PE 的 1.5/2.5/4.5 倍；16×16 MFSA 峰值 0.5/1/2/4 TOPS（FP32/BF16/FP8/FP4）；OBSR 相对朴素 MX 实现省 64.2% 面积、67.5% 能耗；在 BF16+CFP8 基线上补全其余格式仅多 25.7% 面积，支持 NVFP4 额外代价为 11.8% 面积、7.3% 功耗。

为什么值得看 多格式低精度阵列设计的完整工程范例，关注 MX/NVFP4 生态的架构设计者值得细读。

item.title: MAPLE: A Multi-Axis Parametric Knowledge Extraction Lens for LLM Evaluation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

LLMs absorb vast knowledge from training data, yet their inherently probabilistic nature offers no guarantee that this knowledge will surface in their outputs.

LLMs absorb vast knowledge from training data, yet their inherently probabilistic nature offers no guarantee that this knowledge will surface in their outputs. To bridge this gap, Knowledge Extraction Enhancement (KEE) techniques such as activation steering, decoding adjustments, and prompting modify inference, potentially reinforcing existing predictions or surfacing less accessible answers. Yet their evaluations centered on aggregate accuracy, which obscures diverse effects by collapsing recovered failures and disrupted successes into a single score. We introduce MAPLE, a unified framework for characterizing how KEE techniques affect parametric knowledge extraction. Its diagnostic metrics disentangle these effects at the surface, probability, and beyond-sampling levels by measuring answer recovery and disruption, gold-token rank shifts on unrecovered failures, and recovery of answers missed by fixed-budget sampling. We evaluate six KEE techniques spanning decoding, activation steering, and prompting across three model families: OLMo2, Qwen2.5, and Llama3. item.title: MAEM: Mitigating Recency Bias via a Replay-Free, Capacity-Controlled Dynamic Mixture of Experts for Class-Incremental Graph Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) excel on graph-structured data but suffer catastrophic forgetting when classes arrive sequentially.

Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) excel on graph-structured data but suffer catastrophic forgetting when classes arrive sequentially. In class-incremental graph learning, predictions are often dominated by recently learned classes, causing severe recency bias. Dynamic expansion can isolate knowledge across sessions, but many methods assume task-incremental settings and require task identities at test time to select branches or heads---information unavailable in class-incremental learning. Learnable routers offer an alternative, yet continual fine-tuning the router on new data can bias routing toward recent components. We propose MAEM, a replay-free, capacity-controlled dynamic mixture-of-experts framework for class-incremental graph learning. MAEM builds representations with Simplified Graph Convolution (SGC) and trains a dedicated expert for each new session, then freezes it to protect prior knowledge. For routing without task IDs or a shared trainable router, each expert uses a masked autoencoder (MAE); test nodes are assigned to the expert with the lowest reconstruction error, reducing routing-level recency bias. item.title: MA-Bench: Measuring Operational Planning in Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

How well can a language model turn a large, incomplete and partly contradictory body of documents into a plan when no single correct answer exists?

How well can a language model turn a large, incomplete and partly contradictory body of documents into a plan when no single correct answer exists? We introduce Mission Analysis (MA)-Bench, built on mission analysis, the first step of military operational planning, in which a staff reads the full situation and states the problem before anyone proposes a solution. Its 10 expert-built scenarios pair synthetic packets of ten to twelve documents with 1,257 expert-written pass/fail requirements, each containing information on their source, question type, and importance level. A reasoning-model judge grades each brief against the requirements without seeing the documents; it grades like a fifth credentialed planner, leaving a four-planner panel's agreement unchanged (Fleiss $κ$ 0.42 to 0.41), and a judge from a second provider reproduces the model ranking (Spearman 0.94). Across twenty frontier and open-weights models the best gets 62% of the rubric items right. Models are strongest on facts stated in the documents (58%) and weakest on judgments that must be inferred (33%), and six failures in ten are omissions rather than errors. item.content:encoded:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

How well can a language model turn a large, incomplete and partly contradictory body of documents into a plan when no single correct answer exists?

How well can a language model turn a large, incomplete and partly contradictory body of documents into a plan when no single correct answer exists? We introduce Mission Analysis (MA)-Bench, built on mission analysis, the first step of military operational planning, in which a staff reads the full situation and states the problem before anyone proposes a solution. Its 10 expert-built scenarios pair synthetic packets of ten to twelve documents with 1,257 expert-written pass/fail requirements, each containing information on their source, question type, and importance level. item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Understanding the mechanism behind why diffusion models memorize their training data remains an open question in generative modeling.

Understanding the mechanism behind why diffusion models memorize their training data remains an open question in generative modeling. In this paper, we examine this question from two perspectives: (a) the model-level perspective concerning the onset of memorization in a model during training, and (b) the sample-level perspective concerning the proclivity of an individual sample to be memorized by a given model. We show that the so-called input loss curvature, or the Frobenius norm of the Hessian of the diffusion model's training loss, is an effective metric for quantifying both perspectives on memorization. In particular, we empirically demonstrate that input curvatures averaged across training and validation samples can identify when a model is likely to start regurgitating its training data when tracked over training time. However, this metric is not sufficient for measuring an individual sample's likelihood of being memorized. item.title: Local Epochs as Optimal Stopping: Theory and Evidence in Federated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

How long should each client train before communicating?

How long should each client train before communicating? Federated learning usually answers with a fixed, hand-tuned number of local epochs, yet an extra epoch helps only while the loss it removes outweighs the client drift it adds. We cast local training as finite-horizon optimal stopping: a client trains while the next epoch's expected loss reduction exceeds its priced squared drift. We prove that this one-stage look-ahead threshold is optimal whenever stopping decisions are nested, derive closed forms for geometric and power-law returns, and show that an estimated rule loses utility only through wrong-signed decisions. Epoch-level evidence supports the model's structure (geometric diminishing returns and additive drift) and reveals a simple regularity: the stage of training, not the client, sets the budget. The resulting rule, FedStop, is never more than one point below tuned FedAvg in mean accuracy. Where its budgets vary, it raises worst-decile accuracy by 4-8 points over tuned FedAvg and an adaptive-interval baseline, and every one of these gains remains significant after a Holm correction. item.title: Librarian Agents: Training LLMs to Curate Long-Context Workspaces that Anticipate Future Queries
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Reasoning over long document contexts remains a challenge for large language models (LLMs).

Reasoning over long document contexts remains a challenge for large language models (LLMs). Standard retrieval methods are inherently reactive, bottlenecking agents with complex, cross-document reasoning at inference time, while precomputed structures like knowledge graphs often fall short because they rely on rigid heuristics. Instead, can we allow agents to perform anticipatory directed curation: learning to proactively reorganize unstructured corpora prior to inference to efficiently serve diverse future queries. We build on a key asymmetry in modern agentic harnesses (e.g., Claude Code): while LLM agents are adept at navigating existing filesystems to solve an immediate task, they are rarely trained to construct reusable workspaces for future use. To instantiate this capability, we introduce Librarian Agents, a framework in which a builder agent transforms raw documents into a hierarchical filesystem of synthetic files and reference links, which forms a workspace tailored for a downstream answering agent. We formulate workspace construction as a Markov decision process and optimize the builder policy via reinforcement learning to directly maximize downstream answering accuracy.…

item.title: Lethe: Link Inference Attacks For Evaluation of Edge Unlearning Methods
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Graph Unlearning (GU) aims to remove the influence of specific training data from a Graph Neural Network without retraining anew.

Graph Unlearning (GU) aims to remove the influence of specific training data from a Graph Neural Network without retraining anew. While most methods address removal of nodes and features, Edge Unlearning (EU), aiming at forgetting edges, has recently attracted dedicated attention as a standalone problem due to the hardness of completely removing the impact of an edge in the model. Despite this, no dedicated benchmark for EU exists besides isolated evaluations on feature-rich datasets such as Cora and Citeseer where GNNs exploit node features rather than graph structure. As such, we show two systematic limitations in existing evaluations: dedicated EU methods can be slower than retraining anew, and accuracy metrics are uninformative due to the negligible impact of edge removal. To address this gap, we introduce Lethe, the first comprehensive benchmark for Edge Unlearning, featuring 15 methods and 8 datasets. Our benchmark emphasizes large graphs, introduces evaluation tasks of varying difficulty, and proposes empirical measures based on link inference attacks rather than proxy accuracy metrics. item.title: Learning to Steer LLM Agents and Multi-Agent Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Large language model (LLM)-based agents and multi-agent systems increasingly tackle complex tasks through long-horizon tool use and inter-agent collaboration.

Large language model (LLM)-based agents and multi-agent systems increasingly tackle complex tasks through long-horizon tool use and inter-agent collaboration. However, these systems are prone to deviating from the overall goal as execution unfolds, which wastes execution resources and leads to undesired outcomes, a failure termed goal drift. In this work, we propose a steering agent that supervises execution on the fly and steers the system back on track when drift occurs. The steering agent observes the execution context, deciding when to intervene with a low-cost fast path and how to intervene with a high-cost slow path. To unlock its steering intelligence, the ability to assess goal drift and generate effective interventions, we jointly train the two paths with reinforcement learning, combining a pairwise ranking objective with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO). Experiments on information-seeking search tasks show that the steering agent provides effective supervision for both single-agent and multi-agent systems, improving their performance and efficiency. The learned steering intelligence generalizes to out-of-domain tasks, transfers to unseen executors, and supports c…

item.title: Learning to Compute Is Not Learning to Retain or Reuse in Looped Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Looped transformers compute by applying one block repeatedly, so they can run for more loops than they were trained with.

Looped transformers compute by applying one block repeatedly, so they can run for more loops than they were trained with. Recurrent reasoners are known to overthink: iterating past the trained depth can turn a correct answer into a wrong one. Such a late error can reflect failed computation, loss of retention, or a state that later computation cannot reuse. We separate these cases in in-context Mealy-machine execution, where a simulator supplies intermediate targets and exact counterfactuals for hidden-state interventions. Models trained to answer at loop 32 are fully correct there but keep only 22% of these answers at loop 64. Retention depends on what training asks for: supervising one randomly chosen position per example, instead of always the last, keeps 99.8%, and randomizing the number of training loops also helps; truncating gradients, as in progressive training against overthinking, does not. The computation itself is exact: position $k$ is computed at loop $k$, and swapping its loop-$k$ hidden vector for the one from another input redirects every later position to that input's exact continuation (237/237 pairs in each of ten models). item.title: Learning by Examples: Power Grid Steady State Analysis with a Tabular Foundation Model
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Foundation models have shown strong generalization across scientific domains, but their use in power systems remains largely task-specific.

Foundation models have shown strong generalization across scientific domains, but their use in power systems remains largely task-specific. We investigate whether a pretrained tabular foundation model (TFM), TabPFN, can serve as a general-purpose neural solver for power grid steady-state analysis. We evaluate the TFM on three tasks: power flow (PF) prediction, N-k contingency screening (NCS), and voltage stability margin (VSM) prediction. We performed experiments on 118- and 2000-bus systems, comparing the TFM against task-specific neural baselines. Without retraining or fine-tuning, the TFM matches or outperforms the best task-specific model in several settings across the three tasks. For 118-bus PF prediction, a variant of the TFM achieves errors of $1\times 10^{-3}$ pu for voltage magnitudes and $0.30^\circ$ for voltage angles, outperforming all baselines. On unseen N-1 contingency and close-to-infeasible PF cases, the TFM is competitive with the DCPF approximation. For millions of unseen N-2 contingencies, the TFM achieves AUCs of 0.92 and 0.95 for branch and voltage violation screening, respectively. item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Accurate medium- to long-range epidemic forecasting requires extrapolating high-dimensional, heterogeneous and nonstationary dynamics from partial observations.

Accurate medium- to long-range epidemic forecasting requires extrapolating high-dimensional, heterogeneous and nonstationary dynamics from partial observations. Yet hybrid models often leave implicit which observations inform which epidemic processes and how learned graph interactions modify system state. We introduce LE-EpiGNODE, which replaces generic message passing with process-specific, mechanism-guided neural operators: age-contact information drives Lagrangian infection generation, whereas mobility drives conservative Eulerian population transport within a structure-preserving universal differential equation. We evaluated LE-EpiGNODE across 14 controlled synthetic mechanisms spanning time-modulated, state-dependent, nonlinear and coupled dynamics, three complementary COVID-19 settings, 21 comparator models and five targeted ablations. Forecasting gains tended to become more pronounced at longer horizons; at the longest horizon, LE-EpiGNODE achieved the lowest WMAPE in all three real-world datasets, reducing error by 17.7-40.0% relative to the best baseline. item.title: Learning Lean Feedback for Efficient Proof-Candidate Evaluation on GPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Training language models for formal theorem proving requires large numbers of verifier calls.

Training language models for formal theorem proving requires large numbers of verifier calls. Slow checks and timeouts often leave GPUs waiting and withhold rewards from potentially correct proofs. We train neural evaluators to predict Lean 4 verdicts and compiler feedback on GPUs using 4.84M labelled programs. We compare two validity classifiers with a feedback model that annotates proof attempts with predicted goal states and error messages. A two-stage evaluator that screens candidates with a classifier and scores its positive predictions with the feedback model reaches 87.8% accuracy in predicting whether Lean accepts a candidate proof, evaluated on a 68,932-program benchmark collected from public provers. The combined evaluator processes 3.5 candidates per second on one H100, 4.2x the throughput of our 64-worker Lean baseline with environment reuse. Finally, we combine our evaluator with Lean verdicts to obtain a hybrid reward system that shortens GRPO training steps by approximately 31%. After one GRPO epoch with hybrid rewards, the prover achieves nearly the same miniF2F pass@1 as with Lean-only rewards (62.2% versus 62.4%) and a pass@32 of 72.4% versus 71.3%.

item.title: Learnable Hodge-Laplacian Driven Mixture of Experts for Steady-PDE Surrogates on Coarse Unstructured Meshes
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Current approaches for steady partial differential equations surrogate models on unstructured meshes apply a single mixing mechanism to the whole solution.

Current approaches for steady partial differential equations surrogate models on unstructured meshes apply a single mixing mechanism to the whole solution. This paper proposes an architecture that partitions the solution among vanilla transformer experts, each focused on a different spectral scale. The partition is built from a discrete Hodge Laplacian $L_0=\star_0^{-1} d_0^{\top}\star_1 d_0$, that serves as a fitting layer measuring high-frequency content. A gating mechanism takes the mesh as input and produces the per-vertex weights that recombine the expert outputs. AirFRANS is a steady Reynolds-averaged Navier--Stokes (RANS) airfoil benchmark. We evaluate our approach in a reduced remeshed version of the benchmark with each unstructured mesh counting 9.6K faces and 4.9K vertices. We compare our approach with the Transolver on the same dataset and dataset slit. Our approach reduces relative $L_2$ error by 31\% and interior mean squared error by 47\%.

item.title: LatentLoop: Scaling Looped MoE Models with Asymmetric Compute Allocation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 循环 MoE 以参数复用 + 稀疏计算在相同预算下提升性能，但共享参数的各次循环访问作用不同，计算应如何按角色分配尚不清楚。

方法 通过学习独立残差系数发现第一次访问尺度更小、且降低第一次访问尺度不损害甚至改善性能（第二次则相反）；据此提出 LatentLoop：压缩第一次访问的序列长度、第二次保持全分辨率，把省下的计算转投更大隐藏维度；循环间共享 MoE 权重、注意力参数独立以适配不同序列分辨率。

关键数字 1.3B–7B 参数、15 种配置（最大预算超 10^21 FLOPs）下一致降低验证 NLL；在拟合 NLL 1.988 处，相对 vanilla MoE 与循环基线分别预计节省 19.0%、7.9% 计算量，并在 9 个基准的 0-shot/5-shot 下全尺寸提升平均分。

为什么值得看 给出循环架构下"非对称算力分配"的可落地方案，对权重复用与循环网络设计方向有参考意义。

关键数字 1.3B–7B 参数、15 种配置（最大预算超 10^21 FLOPs）下一致降低验证 NLL；在拟合 NLL 1.988 处，相对 vanilla MoE 与循环基线分别预计节省 19.0%、7.9% 计算量，并在 9 个基准的 0-shot/5-shot 下全尺寸提升平均分。

为什么值得看 给出循环架构下"非对称算力分配"的可落地方案，对权重复用与循环网络设计方向有参考意义。

item.title: Language Models Share a Readout Bottleneck in Working Memory
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Large language models (LLMs) reproduce a human working-memory signature on the N-back task: performance declines as memory load N increases, and errors concentrate on lures, items that repeat the current stimulus at a neighboring but incorrect serial position.

Large language models (LLMs) reproduce a human working-memory signature on the N-back task: performance declines as memory load N increases, and errors concentrate on lures, items that repeat the current stimulus at a neighboring but incorrect serial position. We ask whether this shared behavioral signature reflects a shared mechanism. The literature offers two candidate accounts. On a precision account, softmax attention cannot concentrate its weight on the item N positions back, so adjacent items are retrieved instead. On an interference account, attention selects the correct item, but the content of competing items corrupts the decision. We dissociate these accounts in 15 pretrained LLMs from three families (70 million to 14 billion parameters) and in minimal transformers trained from scratch. In all three families, the attention heads that carry the task attend to the target on most missed matches. Linear probes decode near-perfectly whether a matching letter occurred at the target or at a lure position, even on trials where the model false-alarms to the lure, although its own decisions barely distinguish the two. item.title: LLMs program using Reusable and Composable Abstract Representations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

When writing code, the same computation can be expressed in different programming languages and through different implementation strategies.

When writing code, the same computation can be expressed in different programming languages and through different implementation strategies. We show that the activations of LLMs capture this shared structure in reusable and composable abstract representations when they generate code. These representations emerge in the middle layers, are reusable across programming languages, and afford the model an impressive amount of generalization ability when generating code under various interventions. Using activation steering, we show that function, programming language, and implementation strategy can be independently manipulated. The independent interventions on language and function can be flexibly composed to control code generation, even in cases when the prompt contains no information about language and function. We additionally find that finetuning on examples of arbitrarily defined functions in one programming language transfers to other languages, consistent with the models reusing abstract features of code generation that are shared across different examples. item.title: LCT: Losslessly Compressed Tensors with GPU friendly execution for Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 无损张量压缩能降低训练内存，但训练过程要求张量被反复重新编码，编解码开销是关键。

方法 LCT 面向反复编解码场景的 GPU 执行框架：利用浮点数据的天然冗余，用预计算码本的 Huffman 编码压缩权重、激活与优化器状态，高度优化的 GPU kernel 保证低压缩与解压开销。

关键数字 压缩率最高 1.455 倍；162M 参数 NanoGPT 训练内存降 24.6%，步时增加 7.2%；Qwen3-4B 微调峰值内存最多省 23.8%，同一 GPU 上训练上下文长度可放大 3.5 倍。

为什么值得看 无损路线的内存-时间权衡测得清楚，可与其他显存优化手段叠加使用。

item.title: JointServe: Serving Multi-Model Agents on Memory-Constrained GPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM agent 从单模型调工具演进为编排多个专家模型，模型工作集超出显存；在私有/边缘的显存受限 GPU 上，整模型换入换出会把传输与计算串行，且丢失会话状态。

方法 JointServe 把权重分片与 KV 块统一为共享同一内存预算的驻留对象，利用 agent 负载的定向调用、间隙执行、双态驻留三个结构性质：从调用方输出流解析意图信号、在生成期间触发预取；部分 k* 驻留把切换降为增量换层；抢占式传输调度器以保证带宽份额保护活跃会话 KV，另有控制步骤动态调整权重/KV 分配。

关键数字 会话完成时间比最强整模型换页基线低 21.7%；在所有整模型基线都无法完成的崩溃场景中保持可用（46 倍差距）；回放 SWE-bench、tau-bench、OSWorld 轨迹时完成时间最多降 49%，SLO 达成率从 2.8–24.5% 升至 76.8–100%。

为什么值得看 面向多模型 agent 这一新范式的 serving 系统，显存受限设备部署 agent 的团队值得跟进。

item.title: Isolating a Language Model's Judgment with a Label-Free Subspace
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Language models are often asked to make judgments: whether a proposed answer is correct, whether one statement follows logically from another, or whether a response is safe.

Language models are often asked to make judgments: whether a proposed answer is correct, whether one statement follows logically from another, or whether a response is safe. Yet changing the instructions that specify how the judgment should be expressed can make the final answer less reliable, even for the same input. We ask whether this reflects a change in internal judgment or a failure to express it. Comparing hidden-state vectors for the same input under different instructions, we find that their differences concentrate in a low-dimensional expression subspace. We identify this subspace without benchmark labels and remove its contribution from a linear predictor to obtain an isolated judgment. Across correctness, entailment, and safety, the isolated judgment remains reliable under instructions not used to identify the subspace, even when the model's final answer and the original predictor degrade. When the judgment question is negated, isolation raises the predictor's AUROC from 0.504 to 0.825 for entailment and from 0.480 to 0.891 for safety. item.title: Inverse Reasoning Models for Efficient Post-Training and Verification from Answer-Only Data
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Post-training reasoning LLMs often requires making a tradeoff between costly supervision and compute inefficiency: supervised finetuning typically requires reasoning traces, which is data inefficient

Post-training reasoning LLMs often requires making a tradeoff between costly supervision and compute inefficiency: supervised finetuning typically requires reasoning traces, which is data inefficient since in many applications one only has prompt-answer tuples and lacks the groundtruth chain-of-thought (CoT) sequence. On the other hand, reinforcement learning (with verifiable rewards, for example) can operate without CoT data but it is much more compute-inefficient since it requires multiple autoregressive completions per optimization step, none of which are guaranteed to give a non-zero policy gradient. In this work we explore a middleground, a self-distillation technique that uses answer-only data, treating CoT as latent variables. This relies on training a partner ``inverse reasoning LLM" that generates the original's reasoning traces conditioned on the answer. The inverse model is trained once and reused across incoming batches of answer-only data, with all generation happening offline and up front, making the approach particularly suited to continual post-training. Using Qwen3-0.6B on the Countdown and GSM8K tasks, we show that after GRPO training has saturated, a single offli…

item.title: Independent Data-Integrity Verification for LLM-Driven Functional Coverage Closure in Hardware Design
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

LLM agents can write directed tests that close functional coverage, but coverage only shows that a state was reached, not that the data on the way there was correct.

LLM agents can write directed tests that close functional coverage, but coverage only shows that a state was reached, not that the data on the way there was correct. This is a long-known point in verification and we do not claim it as new. We describe a small coverage-closure agent that applies it to an LLM loop: coverage is read from the report that the simulation itself exports (cocotb-coverage YAML) and never taken from the model's account, and data integrity is checked by scoreboards that are separate from the model. On three architecturally distinct RTL designs (an asynchronous FIFO, a UART transmitter and an AHB2APB bridge) the agent raised coverage from 91.7%, 88.9% and 67.4% to 100% within its 8-iteration budget in every logged run, using one design-agnostic agent. A reactive scoreboard monitor attached to the FIFO's base testbench also found a clock-domain-crossing bug in the author's own stimulus code. The monitor is not yet attached to the LLM-generated tests, so their data integrity is not independently checked; one manual check on a single FIFO test is reported as preliminary. item.title: INCONVENIENT: A Benchmark to Assess LLM Generalization Capabilities from Convenience Samples
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Machine learning models for tabular prediction typically assume that training data are representative of the population on which they will be deployed.

Machine learning models for tabular prediction typically assume that training data are representative of the population on which they will be deployed. In practice, however, data are often collected based on convenience, availability, or cost, resulting in systematic sampling biases that can distort feature--target relationships and undermine real-world generalization. Existing tabular distribution-shift benchmarks primarily construct out-of-distribution (OOD) settings by partitioning observations across naturally occurring domains. While such partitions may induce changes in P(Y | X), the resulting shifts are neither explicitly controlled nor isolated, and the evaluation distributions themselves are often not representative of the broader target population. We introduce INCONVENIENT, a benchmark designed to study robustness to convenience-sample bias. Rather than relying on naturally occurring domain partitions, INCONVENIENT directly perturbs feature--target relationships in the training distribution while preserving the original population distribution as the deployment environment. This setting more closely reflects real-world scenarios in which models are developed from unrepre…

item.title: Hyperspherical Contrastive Representations Unlock Planning and Exploration
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

We develop a self-supervised reinforcement learning algorithm that learns to build towers of up to eight cubes from scratch, without prior data, rewards, demonstrations, or pretrained models.

We develop a self-supervised reinforcement learning algorithm that learns to build towers of up to eight cubes from scratch, without prior data, rewards, demonstrations, or pretrained models. Our method, Contrastive Planning via Spherical Linear Interpolation (C-Slerp), uses contrastive representations as reusable building blocks and repeatedly composes them to infer a sequence of intermediate waypoints. Under our hyperspherical parameterization, the learned representations allow intermediate waypoints to be inferred in closed form through spherical linear interpolation, without training a separate high-level policy or performing graph search. Importantly, the representation geometry also tells us how to adjust the number of waypoints based on the difficulty of each goal-reaching problem. Experiments show that our method succeeds on long-horizon navigation and robotic manipulation tasks, including settings where strong baselines fail to achieve a single success. Ablations further show that using a fixed number of waypoints substantially degrades performance, highlighting the importance of adapting the plan to task difficulty.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Human Interventions as Labels: Localizing, Steering, and (Sometimes) Editing the Computations Behind LLM Agent Failures
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

When an LLM agent misbehaves, a human steps in, and that intervention is usually discarded or replayed as training data.

When an LLM agent misbehaves, a human steps in, and that intervention is usually discarded or replayed as training data. We treat it instead as a measurement: a label pointing at the internal computation that failed. We study it in a controlled agent environment, on one failure (asking a clarifying question when the request was already unambiguous), with labels from a rule-based overseer validated against blind human judgment. Claims cover eligible models, which both over-ask and sometimes act on matched unambiguous requests: five of thirteen qualified (Qwen2.5-3B, gemma-2-2b, OLMo-3-7B, Mistral-Nemo-12B, Phi-4). Four findings. First, the ask-vs-act decision is causally localizable in every eligible family: a direction learned from intervention labels flips 72-100% of held-out over-asks at a definite residual-stream depth, with site and dose chosen on training data, and random directions under the same procedure flip at most one episode. Second, over-asking has two mechanistic signatures: in four families the model demonstrably knows the request is unambiguous (the belief is decodable, causally inert and orthogonal to the decision) and asks anyway; in the fifth, the rare over-asks …

item.title: How the Dirty Set Moves: Characterizing Schedule Reuse in Incremental Sparse Matrix Multiplication
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 稀疏矩阵固定、每步仅少数输入行变化（dirty set）的增量稀疏矩阵乘可复用结果，但 inspector-executor 的分块调度在 dirty set 移动后何时仍有利，此前缺乏系统刻画。

方法 在 21 个 SuiteSparse 矩阵与受控的 dirty set 移动模式上，系统比较增量更新、调度复用（分块执行器 + 缓存调度）与全量重算代码。

关键数字 直接按列增量更新比 8 种全量重算实现（含 Intel oneMKL、PyTorch）中最好者快 2.1–8.2 倍；在 837 个工作负载中 779 个优于保留分块调度的执行器；收益来自分块预处理而非调度缓存；仅当分块能把多个非零元合并进同一次输出写时才更快——该结构性质可在测量前预测。

为什么值得看 为增量稀疏计算"何时值得做调度复用"划出清晰边界，对稀疏运行时开发者是实用指南。

item.title: How Many Ranks Does a Token Need? A Noise-Floor Squelch for Rank-One LoRA Experts
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) applies every rank-one component of its update to every token, and mixture-of-experts variants replace this with a learned router that activates a fixed number of components.

Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) applies every rank-one component of its update to every token, and mixture-of-experts variants replace this with a learned router that activates a fixed number of components. We argue that the number of components a token needs is a detection question with a classical answer. A token's responses to the rank-one components of a trained LoRA consist of a few large values on a Gaussian noise floor whose width matches that of an untrained adapter, and the floor carries cross-talk rather than adaptation. We introduce SQUELCH, a router-free mixture of rank-one experts that (i) soft-thresholds each token's responses at a multiple of its own robust noise level, so the active rank varies per token; (ii) chooses that multiple for each module by Stein's unbiased risk estimate, so no rank budget is specified; and (iii) replaces the resulting marginal keep-or-drop decisions by one explaining-away step on the value Gram matrix, which suppresses redundant co-active components and recruits complementary ones. SQUELCH adds no trainable parameters to LoRA. We prove that the squelch is within a logarithmic factor of the oracle input-dependent allocation, that the selected t…

item.title: Helix: A Unified Programmable Accelerator for Diverse Krylov Subspace Solvers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 现有 Krylov 子空间方法的 FPGA 加速器通常只支持单一求解器，或需要独立硬件配置。

方法 Helix 按算法族设计：先从多种 Krylov 求解器抽象公共计算原语，围绕可编程原语 kernel 搭架构，解耦硬件实现与求解器执行，实现 HBM 复用与零求解器切换时延；再配 DSL 编译器把不同求解器高效映射到架构上。

关键数字 在 Xilinx Alveo U55C 上编译运行 8 种求解器：相对 Xilinx XcgSolver 最高加速 7.91 倍，相对 SOTA FPGA 加速器 Callipepla 最高 1.16 倍；吞吐达 RTX PRO 6000 GPU 的 47.5%–96.9%，能效高 2.29–4.66 倍；可编程开销仅 0.25%–0.57% 执行时间与 4.7% LUT、4.0% FF。

为什么值得看 领域加速器「族抽象＋可编程原语」的范本案例，开销数据说明可编程性几乎免费。

item.title: Harness Policy Distillation: Aligning Agent Policies with Runtime Semantics
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Deploying a general-purpose model as an agent means running it inside a product-specific runtime harness that decides which actions are executable, how state advances, and when the loop may terminate.

Deploying a general-purpose model as an agent means running it inside a product-specific runtime harness that decides which actions are executable, how state advances, and when the loop may terminate. Ordinary trajectory supervision shows which action was taken but leaves the runtime semantics behind that action implicit. We introduce Harness Policy Distillation (HPD), which makes these runtime control semantics an explicit training target alongside actions to align the harness policy. HPD replays reference trajectories through the harness to recover the runtime semantics that are implicit in ordinary trajectory data, and represents them as control documents at each model-call boundary. These documents provide privileged information for a teacher to generate actions, while harness verification ensures that the resulting targets are executable under the runtime contract. We jointly train a shared model on the runtime semantics recovered from control-state privileged information and native history, thereby internalizing these semantics into the model policy. At deployment, the trained model uses the original harness interface without requiring the control document or any additional s…

item.title: HankelKANet: Lightweight Path Loss Estimation via Physics-Inspired Hankel Convolution
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Accurate path loss (PL) estimation is essential for wireless network planning and optimization.

Accurate path loss (PL) estimation is essential for wireless network planning and optimization. This paper proposes HankelKANet, a lightweight physics-inspired network for PL estimation that structurally embeds electromagnetic propagation characteristics into the neural architecture. Built on a single residual UNet backbone, the proposed model integrates urban layout features with a convolutional Kolmogorov-Arnold network(KAN). Specifically, the convolutional kernels are parameterized by the radial amplitudes of the zeroth- and first-order Hankel functions. This formulation acts as a physics-inspired nonlinear distance encoding, enabling the network to capture dominant attenuation characteristics directly without requiring additional physics-based loss terms. Experimental results demonstrate that HankelKANet achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and efficiency on both the simulated RadioMapSeer dataset and the real-world Huawei RSRPSet. Compared with the leading baseline, PEFNet, it reduces the parameter count by 78% and lowers the RMSE by 16.96% on the simulated data, while further exhibiting robust cross-dataset transferability and high data efficiency during target-domain adaptatio…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Routability prediction enables rapid evaluation of placement quality without routing, providing effective feedback for routability-driven placement optimization.

Routability prediction enables rapid evaluation of placement quality without routing, providing effective feedback for routability-driven placement optimization. Recent machine learning methods have achieved efficient routability prediction through data-driven approach. However, their prediction performance highly depends on the capability of input representations to capture essential circuit information. To address the limitations of existing circuit representations in simultaneously preserving logical topology, physical layout and routing resource information, this paper proposes HGRP, a heterogeneous graph neural network for routability prediction. HGRP models the cells, nets, and routing grids as distinct types of nodes and explicitly represents topological connectivity, spatial mapping, and grid adjacency, thereby constructing a heterogeneous graph representation that preserves multi-level circuit semantics. Based on the representation, a heterogeneous message passing mechanism is developed to enable information interaction and feature fusion among distinct types of nodes, effectively learning the complex correlations between circuit structures and routing behaviors. item.title: Graph Dirichlet Energy for Fitting-Free Bivariate Causal Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

We propose the Graph Dirichlet Energy Causal Inference (GDECI) criterion for distinguishing cause from effect in bivariate settings.

We propose the Graph Dirichlet Energy Causal Inference (GDECI) criterion for distinguishing cause from effect in bivariate settings. For a candidate direction $X\to Y$, we construct a kernel similarity graph from $X$ and treat $Y$ as a graph signal. The score is the Dirichlet energy of this signal, induced by the unnormalized graph Laplacian. The reverse score swaps the variables, and the lower-energy direction is inferred as causal. The method requires neither regression fitting nor independence testing. After the empirical probability integral transform, its decisions are invariant under strictly monotone transformations of either variable, and the graph operations reduce to convolutions, allowing exact evaluation in $O(n\log n)$ time and $O(n)$ memory. At the population level, GDECI compares degree-weighted Bayes squared prediction errors plus a non-negative smoothness term of the regression function. As the bandwidth tends to zero, the weights become uniform and the smoothness term vanishes, reducing the criterion to a RECI-type comparison of expected conditional variances in copula space. Empirically, we compare GDECI with QCCD, GRCI, CAM, IGCI (two variants), RESIT, LOCI, QPE…

item.title: Generative Representation Learning for Scalable Latent Tokenization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

We introduce an approach for self-supervised representation learning designed to be used as a tokenizer for generative modeling.

We introduce an approach for self-supervised representation learning designed to be used as a tokenizer for generative modeling. Our objective supervises a representation loss by factorizing the pointwise mutual information of the data, which we estimate by taking information differences between conditional predictions from a learned generative model. We justify our algorithm theoretically and empirically, demonstrating that our generative approach to representation learning avoids dimensional collapse and feature suppression in cases where commonly used methods like DINO and LeJEPA fail. Moreover, we show our representation learning technique is scalable; expending more compute leads to predictably better latent tokenization. For the first time, we perform a careful analysis of the combined flop efficiency of tokenizer and generative model and demonstrate that our approach is a compute-optimal improvement over direct diffusion for pixel-space generation, obtaining an FID-50K of 2.18 with JiT-L. Applied to ImageNet and the text-to-image dataset GPIC, we show tokenizer encoder scaling laws for diffusability, where extrapolating our approach achieves representations in 7x fewer FLOPs…

item.title: GBTSVR: Twin Support Vector Regression via Granular Ball Computing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Regression models used in real-world applications are often challenged by noise, outliers, data heterogeneity, and asymmetric error characteristics, which severely limit the effectiveness of conventional point-wise learning models.

Regression models used in real-world applications are often challenged by noise, outliers, data heterogeneity, and asymmetric error characteristics, which severely limit the effectiveness of conventional point-wise learning models. While twin support vector regression (TSVR) partially addresses these issues through the use of nonparallel regression bounds, it still relies on individual samples as basic learning units. As a result, TSVR remains highly sensitive to noisy and contaminated observations and fails to leverage the underlying structural and regional information inherent in complex datasets, leading to suboptimal robustness and generalization performance. To address these limitations, we introduce granular ball twin support vector regression (GBTSVR) and its quantile extension, granular ball twin support vector quantile regression (GB-TSVQR). The proposed models integrate granular ball computing with TSVR, replacing individual data points with compact, structure-preserving granular balls as fundamental learning units. This region-level representation effectively suppresses noise and outliers while preserving intrinsic data geometry, thereby enhancing robustness, stability, …

item.description:

Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves reasoning in language models, but scalar outcomes provide coarse supervision over response trajectories.

Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves reasoning in language models, but scalar outcomes provide coarse supervision over response trajectories. Self-distillation offers denser token-level guidance by comparing an unassisted policy with a feedback-informed self-teacher, yet the teacher evolves with the student, creating unstable targets and motivating additional regularization. We introduce Function-Space Policy Optimization (FSPO), a single-policy framework that combines current privileged adaptation with function-space temporal consolidation. FSPO stores sparse historical next-token distributions as fixed temporal targets, providing temporal separation without maintaining a persistent teacher model. It further introduces privileged disagreement correction to explicitly suppress locally overvalued actions, reliability-adaptive grounding that strengthens reference supervision when self-generated evidence repeatedly fails, and quality and coverage-aware temporal memory that retains verified behaviors and improves privileged demonstrations. item.description:

The semiconductor workforce shortage has renewed interest in making chip design accessible to students without conventional very-large-scale integration (VLSI) training.

The semiconductor workforce shortage has renewed interest in making chip design accessible to students without conventional very-large-scale integration (VLSI) training. We present the AI Hardware Design League (AI-HDL), an international, project-based competition in which students use Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate and iteratively refine Verilog while simulation, synthesis, timing analysis, security review, and physical verification provide the engineering feedback needed to validate the result. Across two annual cycles, AI-HDL grew from 172 to 604 participants and from 40 to 108 teams, reaching 30 universities, six community colleges, and 19 countries. In the 2026 cohort, 68.7% of participants reported no prior Verilog experience. Twenty-two teams completed the four design phases and reached final evaluation. Two division-winning designs completed physical sign-off in the SkyWater 130 nm (Sky130) process, passing design-rule checking and layout-versus-schematic verification with zero violations before being submitted for fabrication. item.title: From Perception to Prediction and Intervention: Benchmarking Proactive Video Assistants in Real-Life Scenarios
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Recent multimodal large language models have advanced video understanding, but existing benchmarks mainly evaluate whether models can interpret observed visual content.

Recent multimodal large language models have advanced video understanding, but existing benchmarks mainly evaluate whether models can interpret observed visual content. In real-world scenarios, assistants must additionally anticipate what assistance is needed and decide when to provide it. To address this gap, we introduce \textsc{P$^3$IBench}, a benchmark for proactive video understanding in real-life streaming scenarios. It evaluates three complementary capabilities: daily perception, risk prediction and intervention. We benchmark 12 representative open-source and proprietary video-language models, including streaming and adapted non-streaming systems. Our evaluation shows that current models struggle to make well-calibrated response decisions. Finally, we construct additional proactive training data and train \textsc{P$^3$I-Assistant-4B}, achieving improvements on several tasks, though gains remain uneven across capabilities. Together, these findings show that effective proactive assistance requires not only visual understanding, but also precise response timing and appropriate restraint.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Fractional Power-of-Two Quantization for Efficient and Effective Multiplier-Free LLM Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 幂二（PoT）量化可用移位-加法实现无乘法器推理，但底数 2 网格过粗，低比特下精度损失明显。

方法 FPoT 改用底数 √2（半八度）的分数幂 PoT 网格量化权重、配均匀整型激活；校准期做网格对齐精化并吸收进静态逐通道缩放，单加法器 √2 近似的误差在权重校准时吸收；数据路径保持全整数移位-加法。

关键数字 Llama-3-8B 上 4-bit 权重加激活，零样本常识推理相对 PoT 基线提升 8.72%，与均匀整型基线仅差 0.4 个百分点；跨 7 个模型、3 种位宽验证，且可与最先进 PTQ 方法叠加。

为什么值得看 给出兼顾精度与硬件效率的实用无乘法器 LLM 推理路线，框架无关。

item.title: FireGraphNet: Sub-daily wildfire spread prediction with directed graph neural networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Wildfire decisions are made in hours, yet most learned spread models predict daily on targets including burned area.

Wildfire decisions are made in hours, yet most learned spread models predict daily on targets including burned area. We propose FireGraphNet which formulates 12-hour growth as node classification on directed H3 graphs, with candidates ahead of the front and wind alignment, terrain, fuel continuity and barriers on edges. On satellite perimeters it achieves average precision 1.7-1.9x the strongest distance baseline on test California fires and 1.62x out of state. We show this skill comes from message passing rather than cell features or the aggregator, is highest on young fires in state, is carried deep along the wind by its edges, and is hidden by pooling. A convolutional network matches this ranking once trained on new growth, at worse calibration, so candidate construction, target definition, and aggregation shape conclusions about model skill. Editing fuel and barrier attributes reduces predicted spread more under guided than random placement, extending FireGraphNet to operational intervention analysis.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: FinGREAT: Evaluating LLMs on Financial Graph-guided Retrieval And Typing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Financial disclosures express the underlying relationships of double-entry accounting through unstructured text.

Financial disclosures express the underlying relationships of double-entry accounting through unstructured text. While financial LLM benchmarks predominantly emphasize question answering and classification, schema-guided evidence discovery remains relatively under-explored. We investigate whether open-weight LLMs can extract and classify evidence corresponding to predefined double-entry accounting relationships underlying the text. Using a financial accounting graph comprising 11 nodes (accounts) and 11 edges (transaction types), we evaluate mid-sized models from 5 open-weight families across 1,300 SEC 10-K Item 7 filings spanning 26 years, comparing their extraction performance against three proprietary models. Results reveal substantial differences in extraction volume, edge distributions, and cross-model agreement. Building on this study, we introduce a human-annotated relation classification benchmark comprising 483 passages across three financial accounting categories, evaluating 34 open-weight and 10 proprietary models. The strongest open-weight and proprietary models achieve 84.1\% and 92.8\% accuracy, respectively, with considerable variation across accounting categories. O…

item.title: Federated Art Chase: Privacy Leakage and Data Poisoning in Federated Fine-Tuning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Federated learning (FL) is increasingly used to adapt a pretrained, centrally fine-tuned model to data that remain on user devices, beyond training a model from scratch.

Federated learning (FL) is increasingly used to adapt a pretrained, centrally fine-tuned model to data that remain on user devices, beyond training a model from scratch. In this report, prepared for the 4th Federated Machine Learning International Summer School, we study the privacy and integrity of this approach with a reproducible pipeline. An ImageNet-pretrained MobileNetV4-Conv-Small model is fine-tuned centrally on ten Quick, Draw! classes (97.50% test accuracy) and then adapted with head-only FedAvg over ten non-IID clients, which raises client training accuracy from 90.34% to 91.49% while preserving global accuracy. We evaluate four adversarial scenarios. First, from a single one-step client update, an honest-but-curious server recovers the complete private label set, but its reconstructions follow class prototypes rather than the private drawings (mean SSIM 0.130). Second, from a one-round FedAvg aggregate, label-count recovery falls from 87.5% with one client to 75.0% with five and ten clients, below the 80.0% of an uninformed uniform guess. Third, under FedAvg, a backdoor injected by 30%, 50%, and 100% of the clients reaches an attack success rate (ASR) of 21.9%, 31.3%, a…

item.title: Fault Detection and Bit-Error Rate Diagnostics in Optical Wireless Links Using Edge-AI
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Optical Wireless Communication (OWC) systems provide high-bandwidth, spatially secure, and RF-interference-free digital transmission.

Optical Wireless Communication (OWC) systems provide high-bandwidth, spatially secure, and RF-interference-free digital transmission. However, direct free-space optical links suffer from extreme sensitivity to line-of-sight disruptions, optical attenuation, high ambient light saturation, and transmitter-receiver misalignment. Traditional channel diagnostic frameworks rely on external computing nodes or cloud-based processing, which introduces severe diagnostic latency and reduces edge node autonomy. This paper presents an autonomous, self-diagnosing optical wireless receiver node that integrates physical-layer signal telemetry extraction with an on-device TinyML classification engine. Built around an ESP32-S3 microcontroller, the receiver recovers 1000 bit/s On-Off Keying (OOK) digital payloads using a 5-sample majority voting mechanism while concurrently extracting real-time channel features: Bit Error Rate (BER), received signal voltage (Vsignal), Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNRdB), and ambient light baseline (Lambient). Evaluated against a Random Forest baseline (77.22% accuracy) and a floating-point neural network (78.48% accuracy), a post-training INT8 quantized TensorFlow Lite Mic…

item.title: FUSE: Fairness-aware Update Screening against Byzantine Exploitation in $q$-Fair Federated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Client-level fair federated learning, in the form of $q$-fair federated learning ($q$-FFL), agnostic federated learning, or tilted empirical risk minimization, has emerged as an attractive solution to equalize utility across heterogeneous clients.

Client-level fair federated learning, in the form of $q$-fair federated learning ($q$-FFL), agnostic federated learning, or tilted empirical risk minimization, has emerged as an attractive solution to equalize utility across heterogeneous clients. This paradigm grants high-loss clients greater relative influence, while a central server aggregates their loss-weighted updates into a single shared model. Yet, the Byzantine robustness of $q$-fair federated learning has been largely neglected, leaving the server unable to tell legitimate fairness-induced amplification from malicious update scaling. To address this critical gap, we formalize the problem of Byzantine-robust $q$-fair federated learning under an \emph{update-only interface}, in which the server observes nothing but the fairness-scaled client updates. Our analysis under shared class-conditional label skew shows that fairness scaling preserves the nonnegative class-mixture structure of honest updates, while replacing their unit-sum constraint by a client-dependent radial scale. Moving beyond magnitude-based screening, we show that this warped geometry supplies two complementary tests, one radial and one structural, that a sin…
